text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I won, Trainer.
I believe I gave a performance
that even I can be truly proud of.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was amazing! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: After-party! It's an oshiruko & monaka party!
After-party! It's an oshiruko & monaka party!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid?! What the heck are you
tryin' to pour down a bone-dry throat?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, you can stop playing the fool now.
The race is already over, after all.
choice_data_list: I guess you're right, congratulations, Luck!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much.
Winning really does feel great, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The cheers and applause directed at me.
Hearing that makes me feel like all the days I endured were worth it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what matters is what comes next.
Today's praise will be forgotten by tomorrow anyway.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"A golden brilliance that stays etched in memory forever.
That's the kind of star performer I strive to be."
choice_data_list: Yeah. But let's at least celebrate today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. If possible, I'd be happier
if we recharged our energy with some high-end yakiniku
instead of a sweet bean soup party.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll find a good spot for Hanagata's pre-celebration!
Got it, I'll find a nice place for Hanagata's pre-celebration.
Wait. You're getting way too carried away, Luck!
Wait. You're getting way too carried away, Luck!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. If possible, I'd be happier
if we recharged our energy with some high-end yakiniku
instead of a sweet bean soup party.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll find a good spot for Hanagata's pre-celebration!
Got it, I'll find a nice place for Hanagata's pre-celebration.
Wait. You're getting way too carried away, Luck!
Wait. You're getting way too carried away, Luck!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: For real? Guess it never hurts to ask.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer,
aren't you more excited than I am?
choice_data_list: Of course! More than anyone else in this venue!
Of course! More than anyone else in this venue!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, at this rate, by the time I become a star,
you're gonna go broke, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a massive flip-flop.
Flipped around like a propeller, that did.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Was it the yakiniku? Was it the yakiniku that went wrong?!
choice_data_list: Let's toast with some sweet red bean soup before the meat.
We should toast with some sweet red bean soup before the meat!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why my throat gets wrecked!
How much oshiruko are ya gonna push on me?!
